newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB goes from predator to prey - brokers.
newsitem.headline: NAB goes from predator to prey - brokers.

text.p: Australia's largest bank, National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB), cannot be ruled out as a takeover target for foreign banks after the release of the Wallis report into Australia's financial system, brokers said.
NAB shares rose sharply on Wednesday after the government released the Wallis report and announced that mergers between the four major banks would not be allowed.

"The only thing that might happen to them (NAB) is that they become a target for overseas banks. That may or may not be possible but there is no chance of them being a predator of one of the others," said a dealer at Brisbane broker, Lance Jones.

Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said the government would remove the blanket ban on foreign takeovers of Australian banks but apply the principle that any large scale transfer of Australian ownership of the financial system to foreigners would be contrary to the national interest.
